title: 故障键盘
summary: 输入字符 i 时会反转当前屏幕字符串，其他字符正常追加，求最终屏幕内容。
insight: 用双端队列和方向标记延迟实际反转。方向正常时新字符放队尾，反向时放队首；遇到 i 只翻转方向。最后按方向从相应一端输出。
pitfalls: 字符 i 不会显示在屏幕上
每个 i 都切换一次方向
连续两个 i 相互抵消
最终输出方向可能仍为反向

solutions.title: 双端队列延迟反转
solutions.idea: 方向标记把每次 O(n) 反转降为常数。
steps: 遇到 i 切换 reversed
其他字符在正常方向加队尾，反向加队首
正常方向从前到后输出，反向从后到前输出

code.java: class Solution { public String finalString(String s){Deque<Character> deque=new ArrayDeque<>();boolean reversed=false;for(char ch:s.toCharArray())if(ch=='i')reversed=!reversed;else if(reversed)deque.addFirst(ch);else deque.addLast(ch);StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();Iterator<Character> iterator=reversed?deque.descendingIterator():deque.iterator();while(iterator.hasNext())answer.append(iterator.next());return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun finalString(s:String):String{val deque=java.util.ArrayDeque<Char>();var reversed=false;for(ch in s)if(ch=='i')reversed=!reversed else if(reversed)deque.addFirst(ch) else deque.addLast(ch);val answer=StringBuilder();while(!deque.isEmpty())answer.append(if(reversed)deque.pollLast() else deque.pollFirst());return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string finalString(string s){deque<char> values;bool reversed=false;for(char ch:s)if(ch=='i')reversed=!reversed;else if(reversed)values.push_front(ch);else values.push_back(ch);string answer;if(reversed)for(auto it=values.rbegin();it!=values.rend();++it)answer+=*it;else for(char ch:values)answer+=ch;return answer;} };
